about: P63 T1 sealed reading-game set: 24 new English sentences written 27. 10. 2026 before the first P63 code change, from the plan's mix only (no lexicon, no run). Families: verb = a verb that names a game the library may not have (cook, juggle, block, fish…); count = a goal with a number (word or digit); general = everything else. verb, hero, foe, item, world and count are the sentence's own words, labelled when written. Opened once in T6 (holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.
